blocks.html: Life moves at lightning speed and to keep up, you need to be in the thick of things. You need to be within reach and ready to go whenever the need arises. Axis Residences, in the heart of the city, is the perfect home base for you.

Located on Pioneer Street in Mandaluyong City, Axis Residences is a gateway for everywhere you need to go. It is a short walk to Robinsons Cybergate Complex and Forum Robinsons, giving you instant access to both work and play. Need to go further afield? Axis Residences’ proximity to C5, EDSA and the Boni MRT Station gives you multiple options for getting around quickly and easily whether you choose to commute or take your own car. With major malls, schools, universities, hospitals and hotels just a short ride away everyone from students to starter families will benefit from its accessibility.

Axis Residences has units that range from studios to 3-bedroom units, meeting your needs whether you are just starting out or already moving up the corporate ladder. Added to its central location, Axis Residences itself is a relaxing oasis in the middle of it all; a safe and secure place you can unwind in after a busy, stressful day. On the quieter side of EDSA, the towers boast of a Fitness Center, a lap and a kiddie pool, a multi-purpose covered activity court and a game room, all great options for letting off some steam, hanging out with your friends, celebrating special occasions or bonding with the family. A pavilion and landscaped gardens provide green spaces where you can soothe your mind and senses. When you’ve had enough rest and relaxation, the metropolis beckons and you are in the center of everything. With neighboring Makati, Bonifacio Global City, Greenhills and Cubao just a short ride away, your options are limitless. Although with everything already in one place, you may find yourself choosing to stay home!

When the days are packed and you have to keep moving, time is of the essence and location is everything. Living in Axis Residences means you are always at the right place at the right time. Everything revolves around you and all you have to do is choose.
Axis Residences is a joint venture project of Robinsons Land Corporation and Federal Land Inc., two of the biggest names in the real estate industry today. For inquiries on Axis Residences, call its sales hotline at 625-2055.
